[[File:Vizam2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Vizam/Legends|Vizam]] using a Gi/9 on the ''Khetanna'']]
The '''Gi/9''' was a small, high-powered anti-personnel [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] produced by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. In use during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] had twenty Gi/9s installed aboard the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']].
